settings.question: Do I need any experience?
settings.answer: None at all. Around 95% of participants have never built anything like this before — we guide you through every step.

settings.question: Can I come with someone?
settings.answer: Yes — many people book with partners or friends. Group discounts are available for 3 or more.

settings.question: Can I use Cycle to Work?
settings.answer: Yes. We're registered with all major providers, so you can typically save 25–39%.

settings.question: What do I leave with?
settings.answer: A complete frame ready for components. We can advise on, or supply, a groupset to finish the build.

settings.question: What should I bring?
settings.answer: Just yourself and old clothes you don't mind getting epoxy on. Tools, materials, safety kit, lunch, tea and coffee are all provided.

settings.question: How long will the frame last?
settings.answer: With proper care, bamboo frames ride for years — we still have frames from our earliest workshops going strong. Our support doesn't end when you leave.
